description: Test script for Item Alternative functionality in ERPNext, including unit tests for sub-contract and production raw material item replacements.

classes.name: TestItemAlternative
classes.description: Unit test class for testing item alternative features related to subcontracting and production raw materials.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Sets up test environment and initializes items.

methods.name: test_alternative_item_for_subcontract_rm
methods.description: Tests replacing subcontract raw material item with an alternative item and verifies stock and purchase receipt updates.

methods.name: test_alternative_item_for_production_rm
methods.description: Tests replacing production raw material item with an alternative item and verifies stock and stock entry updates.

methods.name: make_items
methods.description: Creates necessary items, BOMs, warehouses, and initial stock reconciliations for tests.
